scientific_question: With equal physical observations and exactly matched final model classes, can feedback-driven interventions disambiguate competing causal feature/operator hypotheses better than deterministic random action selection or passive periodic observation? Test hypothesis-driven action choice, paid observation quality, cold numeric prediction, cross-world portability and whole-process CPU.

source.private_rule: Each paid action flips its corresponding visible 6-bit state position. In new-rule worlds it additionally flips one SHA256-secret target bit if >=2 of 3 SHA256-secret balanced 3-of-6 action-membership indicators on current, last, and penultimate actions hold. Missing history slots yield 0. Private masks/target derived independently from WSP85|DEV|seed|mask|slot-v1 and WSP85|DEV|seed|target-v1 and NOT available to learners/policies. Memoryless controls have only base toggle.
source.stageA_first144_actions: SHA256('WSP85|DEV|seed|stageA|step-v1') first8 bytes mod6; identical physically charged but independent sessions across all three arms.

stageB_240_actions.hypothesis_active: Public-history-only, generic 20x20x20 one balanced membership mask per action-history slot, learned partial 3-input Boolean truth tables consistent with charged StageA and subsequent paid outcomes. Rebuild version space every 12 actions, with unknown table cells allowed only in selection phase. Rank one-step present and two-step anticipated outcome disagreement across all consistent source-blind hypotheses plus source-blind unobserved action triple coverage, ties broken by lowest action. No private source fields/labels. If public residual signal is all zero (memoryless control), select maximum uncovered triple diversity. Max 512 consistent hypotheses retained in deterministic lexicographic order for bounded evaluation; same rule before outcomes.
stageB_240_actions.hash_random: SHA256('WSP85|DEV|seed|random|step-v1') first8 bytes mod6, independent of physics.

source.primary_scoring_contexts: The identical frozen 43 contexts from WSP84: empty, all six one-action histories, all 36 two-action histories; all 64 visible states and six actions per context. Score source-private truth ONLY after SHA256 freezing all model predictions for that arm.
source.protected_scientific_cohort: WSP80 seeds 5601..5616 NEVER read, instantiated, or consumed

controls.numeric: Exactly original WSP84 PaidOperatorInducer with identical source code, full 384 charged actions/arm, same abstain rule and cold restoration.
controls.symbolic: Exactly original independent WSP84 truth-table solver with same paid observations and hypothesis class; parity requirement 18/18 arm models. Identical performance rules out numeric intelligence superiority.
controls.neural: Exactly original WSP84 genuine three-restart 25->64 ReLU->6 Adam (6000 gradient steps cap/restart, >=95% paid exact train accuracy convergence), fresh independent restart seed per (world,arm) but unchanged algorithm and action observations. Failure to converge is reported, not hidden.
controls.alternatives: Original WSP83 135-atom two-XOR compiler, same observations. Fixed memoryless base-action flip and paid exact state/action/last2 lookup.
controls.matched_charges: Each arm obtains its own full 384 paid action-consequence rows from same private source initial condition and StageA; no arm observes any other arm's charged labels or private source. Same final fit and scoring classes for all arms.
controls.compute: Report total per-arm acquisition+policy selection+compiler+Adam training+inference process CPU and wall-clock, plus peak RSS diagnostics. Never present partial optimizer-only timing as whole-process speedup.

stop: One frozen cohort, one charged trajectory per arm/world, no retries or newly chosen seeds after first result. Preserve negative or null findings and unqualified neural baselines; no post-outcome threshold or mechanism tuning. Standard engineering defects may be repaired BEFORE first developer first-use with full exact source requalification. Registered scientific source is independently fenced.
interpretation: Developer-only six-bit familiar source family. Active intervention policy has a researcher-provided restricted 8000-hypothesis 3-mask family and two-step planning; numerical weight compilation is unchanged WSP84. An intervention gain is evidence for causal-experiment design, not open-ended representation invention or general intelligence. Symbolic parity precludes numeric intelligence superiority; no inference of AGI or open-world portability.
